description: The tool is published on npm as feature-ledger. You install it once with `npm install -g feature-ledger` and run `ledger` in any project, add it to a JavaScript project with `npm install --save-dev feature-ledger`, or run any command through `npx feature-ledger` without installing anything. Using it no longer means keeping a checkout of the tool itself.

While a first edition is in progress, including the first edition after a redraft, the Markdown docs tag no entry as New. With nothing earlier to compare with, every entry would carry the tag, and the PDF already prints those editions without flags.

Every command that prints a prompt for a coding agent (ledger bootstrap, ledger style rewrite, ledger audit, ledger review and ledger redraft check) takes --prompt-only, which prints the prompt alone. You can pipe it straight to the clipboard, for example with ledger review --prompt-only | pbcopy. Warnings from the explanation still print on your screen.
Adding --help or -h to any command prints that command's part of the help and runs nothing. For example, ledger release cut --help never cuts a release.

Every command refuses an option it does not take, and runs nothing. The error names the option, suggests the one you probably meant, and lists the options that the command takes. For example, ledger release cut --dryrun stops with "did you mean --dry-run?" instead of cutting the release.
